stem: Visible mold-like growth is found on one identified plant during harvest. What should Technician I do?
choices: Blend the small amount into the lot so one suspect plant does not create a disproportionate hold.
Apply the required hold/isolation process to the identified suspect material and keep it out of normal flow pending review.
Remove the visible growth and return the plant to the normal harvest stream if the remaining tissue looks clean.
Discard the entire room immediately so no possibly affected material can move.
rationale: Visible mold-like growth is a plant/product condition that requires controlled isolation, not blending or ad hoc trimming. Technician I should preserve the identity of the suspect material, remove it from normal flow, and follow the hold/escalation process. Whole-room disposition decisions exceed Technician I authority unless the procedure specifically directs them.
